title: Are You Safe?
statementMd:
Seven boys and seven girls from Athens were brought before King Minos. The evil king laughed and said "I hope you enjoy your stay in Crete".

With a loud clang, the doors behind them shut, and darkness reigned. The terrified children huddled together. In the distance they heard a bellowing, unholy roar.

Bravely, they advanced forward, to their doom.

## Input

$n$ ($1 \le n \le 100$) — the dimensions of the labyrinth.

Each of the next $n$ lines contains a string of lowercase English letters of length $n$.
statementZhMd:
雅典的七名男孩和七名女孩被带到米诺斯王面前。邪恶的国王大笑着说：“希望你们喜欢待在克里特岛的日子。”

伴随着一声巨响，他们身后的大门关闭了，黑暗笼罩了一切。惊恐的孩子们紧紧地挤在一起。在远处，他们听到了一阵低沉而邪恶的咆哮声。

他们勇敢地向前走去，走向自己的末日。

## 输入格式

$n$ ($1 \le n \le 100$) —— 迷宫的边长。

接下来的 $n$ 行中，每行包含一个长度为 $n$ 的小写英文字母字符串。
